note: Hand-written (phase 3 design 10.1, 10.3). A token is 16 random bytes, base64url without padding: 22 characters. Its hash is the SHA-256 of the token's ASCII, lowercase hex (patient_id_links.token_hash); tokenRef is the hash's first 12 characters, the only form audit events and notices carry. The URL is the ID link base URL, '/c#', and the token in the fragment. These tokens are made up and deliberately repetitive (all zero bytes, all one bits, a pattern that encodes to dashes), so they cover the base64url alphabet's '-' and '_' without looking like secrets. The API's id-links.ts and the phone's id_link_token.dart must reproduce every value.

shapeOnly.note: Has the shape the server checks, though no 16 bytes encode to it (the last character carries only 2 bits, so it is A, Q, g or w). Accepted and hashed like any other.
